text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Fan Fest has arrived, and the entire area is jam-packed with people. Peeking through the crowd, I spot familiar faces by the gate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Reports of lost children are on the rise. Please be extra careful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you don't know where to go, find an Umamusume! Just look for—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —ears like these, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —a tail like this!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Please let us know if there is anything else you require.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh! This pose… It's so hard to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I know. It's meant to be visually appealing, but it is rather awkward.
choice_data_list: I see you're taking your guide job seriously.
I see you're taking your guide job seriously.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahh?! I'm right here to help you! Don't be scared!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh dear… Calm down, Spe. You're not talking with a lost child.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, you're—Grass's trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew… You aren't lost, then? What a rel—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaah! Big Brotherrrr!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my! But this little girl actually does seem lost.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: L-l-lost?! Then it's our job to—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-where'd she go?! …Graaass?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, I see… You became separated from your older brother, yes?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh… He ran off somewhere… And now I can't find him…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… This way, madam! Your daughter's right over here!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Mommy?!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! I was looking all around for you!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank you both so much… And I believe someone else has something to say as well?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: …Hmph. She can stay lost for all I care.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Goodness…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You know, your sister was calling for you this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: And? She's a loud, annoying brat, and I wish she'd go away!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't talk about your sister like that!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll just volunteer to take your place and become her "big sister."

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'd be so happy to have another cute little sister around. Hehehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Wha? B-Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: S-stop! Where do you think you're taking her?! She's my sister!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I guess someone wants to be a big brother now after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spilled water never returns… There's no erasing words once said.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If there's something you hold dear, you should take proper actions to preserve it.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: W-we made up, okay?! What more do you want?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Just for you to run along and have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, you flatter me. It's only proper to be a good role model for those younger than you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Though I must say, being strict for a child's sake does sting inside.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll quietly accept your words of appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her conflicting feelings, Grass Wonder does an excellent job as a guide, staying firm, polite, and true to herself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Just for you to run along and have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! …C'mon, where are we going next?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, anywhere you want!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: …Yeesh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, it makes me a little jealous. His younger sister clearly adores him dearly…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Eheh. Perhaps I'll call my sister tonight. It's been so long since we spoke.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear me. Have I never told you about her?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I must not have mentioned it, but I'm an older sister.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. ♪ My sister's such an excellent student, she even got invited to a boarding school back in the States.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From there, I sit through nearly an hour of Grass gushing about her little sister in America.
